## Result

A narrow proof audit rules out noninteger parameters for continuous positive trace-class Wishart solutions with injective bounded noise, for any C0 semigroup. The key covariance positivity follows from continuity at time zero, and a finite-rank Itô argument supplies the compressed Laplace transforms.

This is **not a novelty or first-resolution claim**: the same conclusion and finite-rank mechanism already appear in an explicitly credited, unrefereed public candidate dated 22 September 2026. Its broader classification was not audited.
